title: Leon Bridges Reinvents His Sound on 'Happiness Anytime'
summary:
Leon Bridges first stepped into the spotlight in 2015 with his debut album, Coming Home, a collection of retro-soul and R&B songs that became his signature sound. Eleven years later, he is trying something new. His fifth studio album, Happiness Anytime, expands his horizons with Afrobeats, Brazilian music and disco.

The change is easy to hear. On the new album, Bridges trades his acoustic guitar for a live band and electronic accompaniment, in hopes of making his listeners dance. It is less about sitting back and listening, and more about getting up and moving.

"That's what was beautiful about this album. We didn't know what we wanted to make going into it," Bridges told Morning Edition. "But, you know, it was all about cultivating a new sound. And I felt that."

Bridges added that Happiness Anytime reflects his journey as he continues to become a more complex musician. Speaking with NPR's Michel Martin about the project, he discussed the inspiration he draws from witnessing joy in different cultures, the growth he has experienced since his early career, and the importance of reinvention.

That idea - reinvention - runs through the whole record. Instead of repeating the retro-soul style that first made him known, Bridges mixes it with rhythms and sounds from around the world. The result is an album built around happiness, energy and trying something unfamiliar, even after eleven years of success. For listeners who know him from Coming Home, the new record may sound surprising - and that surprise, Bridges suggests, is exactly the point.
why_it_matters: Bridges' change shows how artists can keep growing instead of repeating one successful style. It also shows how music borrows rhythms and joy from cultures around the world.

keywords.explanation: A debut is the first time an artist releases work or performs in public.
Retro-soul is new music made in the style of older soul music.
Afrobeats is a popular music style from West Africa with strong dance rhythms.
Accompaniment is the music played along with a main singer or instrument.
Reinvention means changing yourself or your work into something clearly new.
